title: Valid Anagram
prompt: Given two strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s, and false otherwise.
constraints: s and t consist of lowercase English letters
complexity_target: Solve in linear time with respect to input size.

title: Time Based Key Value Store
prompt: Design a data structure that supports setting a value for a key at a timestamp and getting the most recent value for that key at or before a target timestamp.
constraints: Calls to set for the same key arrive in strictly increasing timestamp order
complexity_target: set should be efficient, and get should avoid scanning the whole history.

title: Sliding Window Median
prompt: You are given an integer array nums and an integer k. Return the median for every contiguous subarray of size k.
complexity_target: Avoid sorting every window from scratch.
